professionalSummary: Three years of product analytics experience at a streaming company, building and maintaining engagement dashboards across phone, tablet and TV platforms for nine product managers.
Defined event tracking for fourteen new features in collaboration with app teams, adhering to the company’s tracking standard and documenting specifications in the analytics repository.
Analyzed feature launches against success metrics following the team’s analysis standard, with reviews by the head of product analytics.
Prepared weekly product review packs, clearly attributing analyses to self or data platform pipelines.
Authored limitation sections for launch analyses and hand‑over notes for dashboards passed to other analysts.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained engagement dashboards for all three app platforms, serving nine product managers.
Defined event tracking for fourteen new features, filing specifications in the analytics repository.
Analyzed feature launches against success metrics, with analyses reviewed by the head of product analytics.
Prepared weekly product review packs, recording ownership of analyses.
Documented limitations and hand‑over conditions for each analysis and dashboard.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Engagement dashboard specification for phone, tablet and TV apps.
Tracking specification for fourteen new features.
Launch analysis with limitation section and hand‑over notes, all stored in the analytics repository.
